entities.summary: Min Jin Lee is a Korean American author and journalist based in Harlem, New York City; her work frequently deals with the Korean diaspora. She is best known for writing Free Food for Millionaires (2007) and Pachinko (2017), a finalist for the National Book Award, and runner-up for the Dayton Literary Peace Prize. In 2019, Lee became a writer-in-residence at Amherst College in Massachusetts. Lee Min Jin was a journalists & chroniclers from Seoul (b. 1968-11-11, Seoul). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
